label: Chancellor
notes: Your primary voice. Runs the tutorial briefings in year one.

label: Marshal
notes: Can command an army personally. Doing so removes them from council.

label: Steward
notes: A venal Steward is the single most expensive appointment in the game.

label: Spymaster
notes: Without a Spymaster you get no advance warning of conspiracies at all.

label: Chaplain
notes: Gateway to the church. A pious Chaplain will resist seizures openly.

label: Chief Justice
notes: Unlocks after year one. Reduces unrest and legitimises punishments.

label: Master of Works
notes: Cuts construction cost and time across the board.

label: Admiral
notes: Only appointable if you hold a coastal province with a port.

label: Court Physician
notes: Reduces your own death chance and plague severity. Also a poisoning vector.
